provides: physical spare/unit relationships that may resolve against Infrastructure without transferring Inventory ownership
Inventory proposal targets and lifecycle facts; Communications remains evidence/proposal authority only
Inventory actions, projections, warnings, bulk preflight and lifecycle states
Inventory summary projections and operational counts
append-oriented Inventory events and correction/supersession relationships

forbidden_dependencies: Inventory must not call Communications to infer or execute Task outcomes.
Inventory must not mutate Objective or Task lifecycle state.
Inventory must not treat Network Element or Site master data as ownership of Device Reference operational relationships.
Inventory must not use generated/exported MSG artifacts as proof of submission, dispatch, receipt or warehouse outcome.
Inventory must not hard-delete accepted lifecycle history as a correction mechanism.
transaction_boundary: Inventory commands validate target identity/dependencies, revalidate current projection, append the minimal authoritative events/relationships and required audit atomically, then publish derived projections. External parsing, operator review, artifact generation and long-running work occur outside the write transaction.
